picks.name: Peverelist
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Pace The Wrecks EP" (October 2, 2026, Livity Sound Recordings) is out today -- four lean, potent workouts (Wreck I-IV) carrying his unmistakable sonic signature.
picks.why_listen: Fresh, functional club tools from a Bristol bass-music mainstay, out the day of this list -- reliable material across a range of tempos.

picks.name: El Búho
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Hogar" (September 18, 2026) is a nine-track album exploring the many meanings of home, blending Andean folk textures with digital cumbia and downtempo electronica, featuring Pita Amor, Humazapas, and Ana Maria Vahos among others.
picks.why_listen: Warm, organic world-cumbia textures with a strong emotional core -- good for a slower, more atmospheric stretch of a set.
